reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: National AI investment as modernization showcase
themes.definition: The speaker's country showcases its investments in AI alongside space, energy and other advanced fields as evidence of national development and regional leadership.
themes.inclusion: Passages naming national investment in AI, or national ambitions to become an AI or technology hub.
themes.exclusion: Passages about AI's global governance or risks.
themes.boundary_cases: When AI is only one entry in a list of national investment fields, also code AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: The UAE continues to expand its investments in artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, healthcare, and education.
My country focuses on anticipating challenges and on investing in advanced fields, such as artificial intelligence, space technology and renewable energy.

themes.label: AI listed among advanced fields
themes.definition: AI is named in a list of technologies or sectors without further elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Passages where AI appears alongside space, renewable energy, science or healthcare as list items.
themes.exclusion: Passages that describe what AI does or should do.
themes.boundary_cases: A regional vision of AI 'thriving' in a list remains a list mention.

examples.quote: where new technology, science, renewable energy and artificial intelligence will thrive

themes.label: AI for sustainable development and services
themes.definition: AI presented as a tool for sustainable development, innovative solutions and government services, deserving international investment.
themes.inclusion: Passages urging use of or investment in AI to accelerate sustainable development or improve business, lives and government services.
themes.exclusion: Mere naming of AI as an investment sector without development purpose.
themes.boundary_cases: Support to other countries' AI capacity should additionally be coded capacity building.

examples.quote: international attention and investments should be directed towards those technologies in order to accelerate sustainable development
my country has sought to harness these tools to advance sustainable development around the world

themes.label: Supporting other countries' AI capacities
themes.definition: Support for other (often Global South) countries in building technological and AI capacity, with responsible and ethical use.
themes.inclusion: Passages offering support to build other states' technological/AI capacity.
themes.boundary_cases: Ethics qualifiers attached to capacity support stay here unless ethics is the main point.

examples.quote: We support countries to build their technological capacities while respecting their national values and priorities

value.rationale: All UAE passages across 2018-2026 treat AI as a national investment and modernization priority, typically listed among advanced fields, with later years adding AI-for-sustainable-development and capacity-support framings; no risk discussion appears.
